status.name: core.window.document
status.description: The main document's time origin, ready state, visibility, applied color scheme, background blur, device pixel ratio, and viewport size.

status.name: core.screen
status.description: The shown screen and the open modal of the main document.

status.name: core.page.error
status.description: The error text shown in the main document, or null.

status.name: core.page.audit
status.description: Interactive elements of the main document (button, input, select, textarea, role=button, contenteditable) that are not connected to a declared command or have no dom name. Each is {tag, expose, command, text}; an empty list means every control runs a command.

status.name: core.projects
status.description: Every saved project with its open state.

status.name: core.project
status.description: The project shown in this window, or null.

status.name: core.layout
status.description: The saved form of the current space layout: grid state, focus, and restore widths, or null.

status.name: core.sidebars
status.description: The drawn sidebars in document order: the sidebar (`left` or `right` for a fixed window sidebar, `<card>:<side>` for an internal card sidebar), placement (`window` or `card`), its set, layout, horizontal or vertical orientation, selected tab or null, the card and active tab its sections receive (for a fixed window sidebar, the focused content card and its active tab while a plugin override applies, otherwise null), the overriding plugin and side of a fixed window sidebar or null, its rectangle, and each section's id, name, fold state, whether its module is mounted, its mount error or null, the text content the module drew, the number of its core.sidebar.section.control elements, and whether its tab text is clipped (always false in list layout).

status.name: core.grid
status.description: The current grid: size, gap, boundary positions, and cards in document order with their rectangles in plane coordinates, or null, with each card's tabs (with the title a surface reported as label, its notice, the footer text it reported, whether it holds unsaved changes as modified, and the operation error it shows as error or null) and the text its content footer shows as status, tool buttons (enabled, hidden, title), header fit, and effective card sidebars by side with set, size, actual collapsed state, requestedCollapsed, autoCollapsed and collapseReason (null or insufficient-width/insufficient-height); fullscreen is the presented card ID or null, and card rectangles describe current presentation.

status.name: core.surfaces
status.description: The native surfaces of the current plane with their plugin, visibility, dimming, declared and applied frames in window coordinates, registered entries as "<kind> <name>", and the page status shown in the card status row: phase loading, ready, or error, and the error message. A tab of a plugin that is not loaded is reported with its plugin, visible true and placeholder set to the reason (missing, disabled, reload, host or unread); a mounted surface reports placeholder null.

status.name: core.drop
status.description: The files last dropped on the window: their URLs, the drop point in page coordinates, the surface under the point, the drop command its plugin declares, and the reason when nothing ran.

status.name: core.notifications
status.description: The operating system's permission for this application's notifications the last failure to request permission, post, or remove a notification, and the tabs of the window whose notification the notification center accepted and that were not removed.

status.name: core.settings
status.description: The effective settings, the project that project-scope changes apply to, the keys that the project overrides, and whether a change is still being saved.

status.name: core.themes
status.description: The theme catalog in order: each theme's name, shape values, and the color tokens of its dark and light modes.

status.name: core.contributions
status.description: The contributions of the installed and enabled plugins to extension points, resolved when the page loaded, sorted by plugin, point and item: the contributing plugin id, the point as <plugin id>.<point>, the item index, the state (connected, provider-missing, version-mismatch or invalid) and the reason, or null for a connected item.

status.name: core.plugins
status.description: The plugin cards of the library plugin page: the registry index URL or null, the registry index or plugin state error or null, one entry per loaded, installed or registry plugin sorted by id with its name, description, state (loaded, disabled, available or reload), installed version and enabled value or null, newest registry version or null, and sidecars with their range and installed version, the latest plugin operation with its state (running, done or failed) and error, or null, whether a plugin waits for a page reload, and the installed plugins whose registry index lists a newer version.

status.name: core.settings-modal
status.description: The settings modal: whether it is open, its section, scope, the plugin search text, the loaded plugin ids listed, the plugin whose page is shown or null, the edited set or null, the rows of declared plugin settings with their label and description, the scroll position of the shown content in points, card rectangle in window coordinates, and its controls with the command each control runs and the option values of each select box.

status.name: core.debug
status.description: The debug view: whether it is open, the path of the state file that opening wrote or null, the files of the logs folder with their path, size in bytes and modification time in milliseconds, the file that the view shows with its kind text or image or null, the scroll position of the shown content in points, the running or last save operation, and the error of the last failed step or operation or null.

status.name: core.picker
status.description: Whether the add, tab, tool or space apps menu is open, its title, and its items in order; group is the card of an item in a grouped menu and null otherwise.

status.name: core.library
status.description: The library screen: the shown page (projects or plugins), the plugin search text, the plugin ids of the cards shown and their action buttons in order, shown and pinned projects, count, search, sort, form state and field values, return button visibility, pending work, empty and no-result notes, error, preview rectangles, and the validation error of each project whose saved layout cannot be opened.

status.name: core.verify
status.description: The latest layout verification rows and the number of failed rows, or null before the first verification.

status.name: core.surface.document
status.description: Registered by every plugin surface page: its address, time origin, ready state, whether the first theme is applied, device pixel ratio, body and viewport sizes, and the root filter, and the page's interactive elements without a command binding or dom name (`unbound`, as in core.page.audit).

status.name: core.surface.input
status.description: Registered by every plugin surface page: its last 32 pointer, click, wheel, and key events in order, with the modifier keys each event carries.

status.name: core.modal
status.description: The open native modal of this window with the state its document reported, or null.

status.name: core.drag
status.description: The tab drag in progress: the dragged tab, its card, whether it moved, the drop target, and the drop preview in plane coordinates; null without a drag.

status.name: core.rename
status.description: The tab being renamed in place: its kind, id, and current input value; null when nothing is renamed.

status.name: core.pointer
status.description: The last pointer sequence that the main document received: a press increments sequence, and down, up and click name the exposed element (or tag) that received pointerdown, pointerup and click; pressedConnected tells whether the pressed element was still in the document at pointerup. A click is missing when the pressed element was replaced before the release.

status.name: core.focus
status.description: The exposed element that has keyboard focus in the main document, including surface modules mounted in shadow roots: its name, its index within its own document or shadow root, and the surface id (null in the main document); null when focus is elsewhere. Changes with every focus transition.

status.name: core.text
status.description: The text size scope and factors: the frame factor and each card's factor.

status.name: core.chrome
status.description: The window chrome: the width reserved for the window's own buttons and where the project tabs stand.

status.name: core.rail
status.description: The rail outline path in plane coordinates and the focus corner mark rectangle; null without a layout.

commands.name: core.settings.set
commands.description: Changes settings in the common or project scope and resolves after the change is saved.

commands.name: core.settings.reset
commands.description: Removes the project override of one setting.

commands.name: core.settings.open
commands.description: Opens the settings modal.

commands.name: core.settings.close
commands.description: Closes the settings modal.

commands.name: core.debug.open
commands.description: Closes the settings modal, opens the debug view, records the state of every window into the logs folder and lists the files of the logs folder.

commands.name: core.debug.close
commands.description: Closes the debug view.

commands.name: core.debug.save
commands.description: Saves one file of the logs folder through the save panel where the person chooses; answers the chosen path, or null when the person cancels.

commands.name: core.debug.save-all
commands.description: Saves the logs folder as one gzip-compressed tar file through the save panel where the person chooses; answers the chosen path, or null when the person cancels.

commands.name: core.debug.view
commands.description: Shows the content of one text file of the logs folder in the open debug view: the whole file, or its last 262144 bytes.

commands.name: core.debug.list
commands.description: Shows the list of the files of the logs folder again in the open debug view.

commands.name: core.projects.browse
commands.description: Shows the project library in this window.

commands.name: core.projects.flush
commands.description: Saves the current layout, settings, and window geometry.

commands.name: core.project.open
commands.description: Registers the directory as a project with a fresh layout and opens it; returns the project.

commands.name: core.project.activate
commands.description: Opens a saved project.

commands.name: core.project.close
commands.description: Closes and removes a project.

commands.name: core.project.rename
commands.description: Renames a project.

commands.name: core.project.move
commands.description: Moves a project in the saved order by delta positions.

commands.name: core.project.pin
commands.description: Pins or unpins a project.

commands.name: core.window.new
commands.description: Opens a new unassigned window.

commands.name: core.folder.create
commands.description: Creates a project folder through the host and returns its root and identity.

commands.name: core.space.add
commands.description: Adds a space with a fresh layout, shows it, and returns its id and title.

commands.name: core.space.activate
commands.description: Shows a space of the current project.

commands.name: core.space.rename
commands.description: Renames a space of the current project.

commands.name: core.space.close
commands.description: Closes a space of the current project.

commands.name: core.grid.size
commands.description: Sets the width or height of a card on an axis and redraws.

commands.name: core.boundary.move
commands.description: Moves boundary line on axis to a position in plane coordinates and redraws; returns the resulting position.

commands.name: core.layout.balance
commands.description: Gives every card of the current space a fair share of the plane and keeps the arrangement; a cut gives its sides room in proportion to the cards they hold along its axis, counted on their fullest row.

commands.name: core.settings.change
commands.description: Sets one setting from a control value; strings are converted to the setting's type. Without scope it sets the common value.

commands.name: core.settings.theme
commands.description: Applies a theme with its shape values in the given mode (the current mode by default) and scope (common by default).

commands.name: core.settings.link
commands.description: Changes a general window, plugin window, or card-side choice. A set ID selects a set; off removes the link. Window choices have no inheritance.

commands.name: core.settings.sets.create
commands.description: Adds a sidebar set titled 새 세트 with layout list and no sections to the scope, opens it for editing when settings are open, and returns its id.

commands.name: core.settings.sets.update
commands.description: Changes the title or the layout of a sidebar set in the scope; a rejected change fails with invalid params.

commands.name: core.settings.sets.row
commands.description: Changes one section row of a sidebar set in the scope: choose replaces row index with section, up and down swap it with a neighbour, remove deletes it, and add appends the first registered section the set lacks. A repeated section or an impossible move fails with invalid params.

commands.name: core.settings.sets.delete
commands.description: Removes a sidebar set and every link to it in the scope in one change.

commands.name: core.settings-modal.nav
commands.description: Shows a section of the open settings modal.

commands.name: core.settings-modal.scope
commands.description: Shows the common or project scope in the open settings modal.

commands.name: core.settings-modal.move
commands.description: Moves the open settings card by dx, dy points, kept inside the window.

commands.name: core.plugins.install
commands.description: Installs a plugin from the registry index through the host, as sok plugin install does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window reloads its page after the questions of its modified tabs.

commands.name: core.plugins.update
commands.description: Installs the selected version of an installed plugin through the host, as sok plugin update does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window reloads its page after the questions of its modified tabs.

commands.name: core.plugins.remove
commands.description: Removes an installed plugin through the host, as sok plugin remove does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window reloads its page after the questions of its modified tabs.

commands.name: core.plugins.enable
commands.description: Enables an installed plugin through the host, as sok plugin enable does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window reloads its page after the questions of its modified tabs.

commands.name: core.plugins.disable
commands.description: Disables an installed plugin through the host, as sok plugin disable does; the host applies the change to its sidecars and every window reloads its page after the questions of its modified tabs.

commands.name: core.plugins.apply
commands.description: Asks for each modified tab of the window whether to save it, discard its changes or keep the page, then saves the projects and reloads the page so that it loads the plugins that installed.json lists; answers reloaded false when a tab is kept.

commands.name: core.plugins.replace
commands.description: Replaces the outdated persistent service of a sidecar after its sessions end, as the plugin screen offers, and reads the outdated sidecars again; fails with the host error when the sidecar has no running service of another version.

commands.name: core.plugins.registry
commands.description: Sets the registry index that plugin operations read, through the host, as sok registry use does, and reads the plugin state again.

commands.name: core.plugins.browse
commands.description: Closes the settings modal when it is open, shows the library when the window shows a workspace, and selects its plugin page.

commands.name: core.settings-modal.plugin
commands.description: Opens the settings page of a loaded plugin in the plugins section of the open settings modal; a null plugin returns to the list.

commands.name: core.settings-modal.search
commands.description: Sets the plugin search text of the open settings modal; the list shows loaded plugins whose id, name, or description contains it, ignoring letter case.

commands.name: core.settings-modal.edit
commands.description: Opens the editor of a sidebar set in the open settings modal; a null set closes the editor.

commands.name: core.text.larger
commands.description: Enlarges the text of the current text size scope: the last pressed card, or the frame and every card.

commands.name: core.text.smaller
commands.description: Reduces the text of the current text size scope.

commands.name: core.text.reset
commands.description: Restores the text of the current text size scope to factor 1.

commands.name: core.card.focus
commands.description: Focuses a card.

commands.name: core.card.fullscreen
commands.description: Toggles one content card across the work area without changing the saved arrangement or OS window state.

commands.name: core.card.menu
commands.description: Opens or closes a card's add or split menu.

commands.name: core.card.sidebar.set
commands.description: Assigns a set, disables the side with off, or restores the plugin default with inherit.

commands.name: core.card.sidebar.toggle
commands.description: Folds or unfolds one card sidebar without changing the card size.

commands.name: core.card.sidebar.size
commands.description: Sets one card sidebar width or height within the configured bounds.

commands.name: core.sidebar.section.select
commands.description: Shows one section of a sidebar whose set uses the tabs layout; the selection is kept for that sidebar.

commands.name: core.sidebar.section.fold
commands.description: Folds or unfolds one section of a sidebar whose set uses the list layout; the state is kept for that sidebar.

commands.name: core.card.tab-list
commands.description: Opens or closes a card's tab list.

commands.name: core.card.tools
commands.description: Opens or closes a card's tool menu, which a narrow card header shows instead of its tools; its items run the same commands as the sidebar buttons and the enabled tools.

commands.name: core.space.apps
commands.description: Opens or closes the space apps list of a fullscreen card: every tab of the space in groups by card, in the order of the tree of cuts of the arrangement; picking a tab moves fullscreen to its card and shows it.

commands.name: core.file.open
commands.description: Opens the file at path, relative to the project root, in the loaded plugin whose surface.opens declares its extension, or else in the plugin that declares *: activates the tab of that plugin with the same path, or adds a tab with params {path} to card or to the focused card.

commands.name: core.card.add-tab
commands.description: Adds a tab of a plugin to a card and activates it. params, when given, must match the plugin's surface.params and are stored with the tab.

commands.name: core.card.split
commands.description: Splits a card and puts a new tab of a plugin in a new card on the named side of it: left, right, top, or bottom.

commands.name: core.card.close
commands.description: Closes a card with all its tabs. When a tab of the card is modified, the workbench asks about that tab first, the result is closed false, and the card closes after its modified tabs are saved or discarded.

commands.name: core.tab.select
commands.description: Activates a tab and focuses its card.

commands.name: core.tab.close
commands.description: Closes a tab; the last tab closes its card when the card can close. A modified tab is not closed: the workbench asks whether to save, discard or keep it, and the result is closed false.

commands.name: core.tab.move
commands.description: Moves a tab to the centre (as a tab) or an edge (as a new card) of a card, as a drop does.

commands.name: core.picker.pick
commands.description: Picks an item of the open menu by index.

commands.name: core.picker.close
commands.description: Closes the open menu without picking.

commands.name: core.library.page
commands.description: Shows a page of the library: projects or plugins.

commands.name: core.library.plugins.search
commands.description: Sets the plugin search text of the library plugin page; the page shows plugins whose id, name, or description contains it, ignoring letter case.

commands.name: core.library.search
commands.description: Sets the library search text.

commands.name: core.library.sort
commands.description: Sets the library sort order.

commands.name: core.library.open
commands.description: Opens a project from the library in place and shows its workspace.

commands.name: core.library.pin
commands.description: Pins or unpins a project from the library.

commands.name: core.library.remove
commands.description: Removes a project and its spaces from the library. The project folder is not changed.

commands.name: core.library.window
commands.description: Opens a new window from the library.

commands.name: core.library.return
commands.description: Returns to the active project's workspace.

commands.name: core.library.form.open
commands.description: Opens the library form to create a project folder or to open an existing folder.

commands.name: core.library.form.cancel
commands.description: Closes the library form.

commands.name: core.library.form.set
commands.description: Sets a field of the library form.

commands.name: core.library.form.submit
commands.description: Submits the library form: creates the folder when asked, then opens it as a project.

commands.name: core.library.choose-folder
commands.description: Asks for a folder with the system dialog and puts it in the form's parent field.

commands.name: core.rename.begin
commands.description: Starts renaming a project or space tab in place.

commands.name: core.rename.set
commands.description: Sets the value of the tab being renamed.

commands.name: core.rename.commit
commands.description: Saves the new name; an empty name keeps the old one.

commands.name: core.rename.cancel
commands.description: Stops renaming without saving.

commands.name: core.focus.set
commands.description: Gives keyboard focus to an exposed element of the main document.

commands.name: core.surface.hit
commands.description: Registered by every plugin surface page: whether an element of the document is at the point in CSS pixels.

dom.name: core.chrome.settings

dom.name: core.space-tab

dom.name: core.space-tab.add
dom.description: The space tab add button.

dom.name: core.card.tab
dom.description: The tabs of every card in document order.

dom.name: core.card.sidebar.grip
dom.description: The dividers of card sidebars in document order; dragging sizes a side and clicking folds or unfolds it.

dom.name: core.sidebar

dom.name: core.card.header

dom.name: core.card.status

dom.name: core.sidebar.status

dom.name: core.sidebar.fold

dom.name: core.card.sidebar.status

dom.name: core.sidebar.section

dom.name: core.sidebar.section.control

dom.name: core.sidebar.section.header

dom.name: core.sidebar.tabs
dom.description: The tab strips of tabs-layout sidebars in document order.

dom.name: core.sidebar.section.name
dom.description: The names in the fold headers of list-layout sidebars in document order.

dom.name: core.sidebar.section.tab
dom.description: The section tabs of tabs-layout sidebars in document order.

dom.name: core.card.add
dom.description: The add-tab buttons of pane cards in document order.

dom.name: core.card.split-x
dom.description: The vertical split buttons of pane cards in document order.

dom.name: core.card.split-y
dom.description: The horizontal split buttons of pane cards in document order.

dom.name: core.card.fullscreen
dom.description: The card fullscreen toggles immediately before each header close button, in document order.

dom.name: core.card.close
dom.description: The close buttons of pane cards in document order.

dom.name: core.picker.item

dom.name: core.library.page

dom.name: core.library.plugins.action

dom.name: core.library.plugins.replace

dom.name: core.debug.scrim

dom.name: core.settings-modal.card
dom.description: The settings card in the main document; the native modal draws it at the same rectangle.

dom.name: core.settings-modal.scrim

dom.name: core.settings-modal.grip
dom.description: The settings header that moves the card.

dom.name: core.settings-modal.close

dom.name: core.settings-modal.set

dom.name: core.settings-modal.reset

dom.name: core.settings-modal.search
dom.description: The plugin search field.

dom.name: core.card.placeholder-action
dom.description: The 설치 or 사용 button of a placeholder card for a tab of a plugin that is not loaded, bound to core.plugins.install or core.plugins.enable.
